name: Dean Heyl
current_role: Assistant Secretary of Labor for Administration and Management
summary: Dean Heyl runs the Labor Department’s Office of the Assistant Secretary for Administration and Management, which handles its budget, personnel, technology and facilities. He joined in February 2025 as assistant secretary for public affairs; he had been director of the office of public liaison in Trump’s first-term Labor Department and later ran his own firm, Heyl Enterprises.
